title: AI image models tie photorealism to dark backgrounds, so lighting cues in the prompt must sever the link
body:
- AI image models trained on portraits with dramatic lighting have learned to associate photorealistic rendering with darker backgrounds.
- A photorealistic prompt without intervention defaults to a dark or moody scene even when the intent is a brighter one.
- Adding explicit brightness terms to the background — "bright neutral background," "soft white glow" — breaks the association while preserving facial realism.
- "High-key lighting, soft gradient background, light neutral tones" forces lighter background values while keeping subject contrast and facial detail.
- Studio lighting terms — backlight, softbox, rim lighting — invoke professional photography setups where subject and background lighting are controlled independently, producing high subject contrast with a background that fades to lighter values.
- Case: "photorealistic, high-key lighting, soft gradient background, light neutral tones, studio backlight, softbox lighting, rim lighting."
conversion: A request for photorealism in an AI image model inherits a dark background unless lighting cues break the model's learned link between the two.
